items.period: Shang-period oracle-bone script tradition; the file description does not date an individual specimen
items.tradition: Oracle-bone script; modern digital vector redraw
items.caption: A modern vector redraw of a catalogued oracle-bone form of 出. Paleographic sources interpret its upper element as a foot and its lower element as an enclosure-like form.
items.alt: Vector tracing of an oracle-bone-style 出 form, shown in black on a light background; this is a modern redraw, not an artifact photograph.
items.selection_reason: A source-described, public-domain candidate illustrating the foot-and-enclosure analysis. The file description ties it to the Sears ChineseEtymology reference J15041; its pixels were not inspected here.
items.rights: Public domain, as marked in the file description; verify the file-page statement when reusing.

limitations.text: This is a modern digital redraw of an attributed oracle-script form, not an ancient artifact photograph. The direct SVG fetch failed with a cache miss, so its pixels were not inspected.
